acceptance_criteria.criterion: Submitting a mismatched translation over HTTP (JS disabled) skips that entry and shows a MESSAGE_WARNING session warning on next page load
Translations with matching placeholder sets (including both empty) are saved normally
Source hashes not found in the collection are saved without blocking
composer analyze passes with no new PHPStan errors

summary: Added server-side placeholder mismatch guard in executeSave(): looks up source text via $collection->hashExists()/$collection->getHash(), compares sorted getPlaceholderNumbers() arrays, skips save and adds MESSAGE_WARNING via addMessage() if sets differ.
Hashes not in the collection pass through without blocking (null guard). Empty sets (both sides) are treated as matching.
composer analyze: no errors. composer test: 95/95 pass.

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent.
